findings.subject: src/pilot/game_heap.cpp:7-8 (func_0010d604 and func_001167f8)
findings.summary: Preserve the configuration pointer type across both factory interfaces. The actual caller func_00103c88 builds a 24-byte configuration on the stack and passes its address to func_0010d604 at 0x00103ee8. The factory forwards that address as the third argument to func_001167f8, whose consuming implementation copies 24 bytes from that address into Widget storage at offset 0x30 (0x0011682c-0x00116830). Both new declarations instead type this address as int parameter. A type-correct C++ caller cannot pass the observed configuration pointer to this API without an invalid pointer-to-int conversion, and the constructor declaration likewise hides its required pointer dereference. The 32-bit target happens to MATCH because an int and pointer occupy the same argument register; this does not satisfy the required real cross-unit types or the manually reviewed C++ interface. Introduce a shared configuration type, opaque if necessary here, and use a pointer to it for both parameters.
findings.title: Preserve the configuration pointer type across both factory interfaces
